QuestInfo.name: Dr. Faymus's Request
QuestInfo.parent: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Other Request
QuestInfo.1: #p406# thinks I've grown a lot since my last visit; she's going to start giving me tasks of a slightly higher difficulty from here on out. First, she told me that #p410#, the owner of Kerning City Pharmacy, was working on a new potion when he ran out of ingredients. He needs me to hunt #r40 #o18#s#k and #r40 #o19#s#k, and collect #b20 #t4000018#s#k and #b20 #t4000019#s#k. Taking on #o18#s could be a bit tricky, but for me, it shouldn't be too much trouble!
QuestInfo.2: I delivered what #p410# asked for and got a bunch of #t2000002#s in return. I wonder what kind of potion #p410# will make using those materials. Return to #p406# for another gig.

0.0: You're the one that helped me take care of #b#p414##k's request, right? He should be enjoying his seafood soup right about now... But hey, you look much stronger than before! All right, if that's the case... You can probably take care on some tougher gigs now.
0.1: I have a new job for you, actually. #b#p410##k of Famous Pharmacy needs help. He'd been working on creating a new potion, when, one day, he realized he was out of ingredients. They are pretty hard to find, and he claims that it's slowing down his experiments...
0.2: He wants to get the ingredients quickly, so he can continue his research. He needs you to hunt #r40 #o18#s#k and #r40 #o19#s#k, and collect #b20 #t4000018#s#k and #b20 #t4000019#s#k... That shouldn't be too difficult for someone like you. Come see me once you've gathered everything. I'll be waiting!

1.0: I knew it... I knew you could get it done quickly! You did your job well last time, and here you are again, taking care of business! All right, since you have done so well, I should reward you well. #b#p410##k is giving you #b30 #t2000002#s#k to help you in your adventure.

yes.0: All right, if you need work sometime down the road, feel free to come back and see me.

item.0: I see you still haven't gathered the materials that #b#p410##k requested. He needs you to hunt #b40 #o18#s#k and #b40 #o19#s#k, and collect #b20 #t4000018#s#k and #b20 #t4000019#s#k in order to conduct the research for a new potion. Just bring everything to me once you're done. You got this!

mob.0: You didn't forget that part of his request was to hunt #r40 #o18#s#k and #r40 #o19#s#k, right?
